note: Canonical Claude Code hook wiring for this dotfiles control plane. ~/.claude/settings.json is device-local and holds device-only keys (model, theme, permissions), so it is not symlinked. `ai-hooks-install` merges these entries into it idempotently and touches nothing else; `ai-hooks-install --check` reports drift without writing. Wiring used to be hand-maintained, which meant a fresh device had git-guard.sh on disk and no hook invoking it, while ai-doctor still reported green because it only ran the guard's test script.

hooks.why: Safety control. The permissions allowlist is a prefix matcher and cannot see flags, so `Bash(git push:*)` waves through --force, --mirror, --delete, and forced refspecs. This hook restores that boundary mechanically. Fails closed.

Observability. Feeds ai-memory-access so ai-memory-lifecycle has real usage data to give retention advice from. Records selected memory paths and byte counts only — never the prompt, never a hash of it, never file contents. Fails open: any error exits 0 silently and the turn is unaffected.
